description: Automatically maintained; seeded from original embodied.md. Code status means verified scope, not acceptance.

papers.title: MoViC: Real-Time Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Monocular Video Streams
papers.summary: live monocular RGB reconstruction, retargeting and asynchronous humanoid motion tracking

papers.title: VideoMimic: Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
papers.summary: reconstructs human motion and scene geometry from monocular video, then retargets and learns scene-aware humanoid imitation

papers.title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
papers.summary: uses external body/hand pose estimators for real-time humanoid shadowing and imitation-data collection

papers.title: ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture
papers.summary: monocular body/hand/foot motion in SMPL-X, with humanoid export through GMR; its repository currently provides demo code, **not** training/evaluation code

papers.title: GVHMR: World-Grounded Human Motion Recovery via Gravity-View Coordinates
papers.summary: monocular video to world-grounded human motion, useful upstream of robot retargeting

papers.title: OnlineHMR: Video-based Online World-Grounded Human Mesh Recovery
papers.summary: causal, streaming video-to-SMPL motion; a perception component, **not** a demonstrated robot tracking policy

papers.title: GMR: General Motion Retargeting
papers.summary: maps human motion (including GVHMR outputs) onto multiple humanoid embodiments, including Unitree G1; it is a bridge, not an HMR method

papers.title: TWIST: Teleoperated Whole-Body Imitation System
papers.summary: a whole-body humanoid reference tracker trained with RL/BC from retargeted human MoCap data

papers.title: TWIST2: Scalable, Portable, and Holistic Humanoid Data Collection System
papers.summary: PICO 4 Ultra motion input, retargeting and whole-body tracking on Unitree G1; not camera-based mesh recovery. Teleoperation code is available, while the higher-level policy-learning component is separate

papers.title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.summary: a generalist humanoid motion tracker that can execute recovered human motion references; **not** a mesh-recovery model

papers.title: Hand2Robot: Object-Centric 4D Hand Reconstruction from Human Demonstrations for Robotics
papers.summary: object-centric 4D hand-object recovery and robot-action supervision through contact refinement and retargeting; **paper link only (code not confirmed).**

papers.title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video
papers.summary: monocular hand-object reconstruction, contact-aware retargeting and physics-refined dexterous robot trajectories; **paper link only (code not confirmed).**

papers.title: VideoManip: Dexterous Manipulation Policies from RGB Human Videos via 4D Hand-Object Trajectory Reconstruction
papers.summary: reconstructs 3D hand-object trajectories from RGB video and retargets to robot hands, including LEAP Hand. **Reconstruction/retargeting code is released; grasping and manipulation-policy training are not yet released.**

papers.title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
papers.summary: reconstructs hand-object demonstrations from monocular RGB videos, retargets them and supports real-world robot replay

papers.title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos
papers.summary: converts egocentric human-hand data to multiple robot hands; a downstream robot learning suite rather than a new hand mesh estimator

papers.title: MINT: A Unified Model for World-Space Camera and Hand Motion Estimation from Scalable Egocentric Pipeline Supervision
papers.summary: recovers camera and two-hand motion in world coordinates from egocentric videos, suitable as input to downstream robot-hand retargeting

papers.title: HaWoR: World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
papers.summary: reconstructs world-coordinate hand trajectories from egocentric videos as a useful upstream hand-motion reference for robotics

papers.title: ManipTrans: Efficient Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation Transfer via Residual Learning
papers.summary: transfers bimanual human hand-object demonstrations to physically feasible robot-hand motions

papers.title: DexMV: Imitation Learning for Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos
papers.summary: recovers and transfers human hand-object demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation learning

papers.title: DexTrack: Towards Generalizable Neural Tracking Control for Dexterous Manipulation from Human References
papers.summary: generalizable dexterous robot tracking from human-object references; a controller rather than a hand reconstruction method

papers.title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
papers.summary: tracks and corrects retargeted, language-generated hand-object references on robot hardware; **not** a hand mesh reconstruction method

toolkits.name: dex-retargeting (AnyTeleop)
toolkits.summary: reusable optimizers translating estimated human-hand motion into robot-hand joint targets; supports video- and dataset-based examples
